title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz
seo_title: Mahj Mondays: American Mahjong Open Play in Springfield
description: Mahj Mondays is a free open play night for American Mahjong at The Gallery at the Gillioz Theatre, run with Blooming Bams. It is for players who already know American Mahjong (NMJL rules) at any skill level; drop in or stay the whole time, bring your own 2026 NMJL card, and use one of the provided tile sets or bring your own. It takes place Monday, December 7, 2026, from 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM at 325 Park Central E. in Springfield, MO.
venue: The Gallery at the Gillioz Theatre
